You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 32 of 50 (script duration 154.4 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E22: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
E23: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
E26: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
E27: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
E28: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
E29: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
E30: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
E31: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
Direct lead-in to E32: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-3.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
[L002 0.0-2.8] SFX: Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
[L003 3.0-4.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.
[L004 3.8-5.2] CATHERINE (Mocking, Savoring): "There it is."
[L005 4.5-7.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
[L006 7.5-9.2] CATHERINE (Whispering, Venomous): "Fear."
[L007 7.5-10.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
[L008 9.8-13.2] CATHERINE (Taunting): "You have been so proud of that brave little face..."
[L009 10.5-13.5] SCREEN: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
[L010 13.4-15.8] CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant): "...but now you are afraid."
[L011 13.5-16.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
[L012 16.0-17.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
[L013 16.2-18.8] CATHERINE (Cruel, Final): "Say goodbye to your mother."
[L014 17.0-19.0] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
[L015 18.8-20.5] ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
[L016 19.0-20.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
[L017 20.2-22.0] JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken): "Burn it."
[L018 20.5-23.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
[L019 23.0-25.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
[L020 23.8-24.8] CATHERINE (Disconcerted): "What?"
[L021 25.5-28.5] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
[L022 25.8-28.8] JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
[L023 28.5-30.8] SCREEN: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
[L024 29.8-32.8] JULIANA (Steely, Proud): "You may destroy the book..."
[L025 30.8-33.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
[L026 33.2-36.2] JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant): "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
[L027 33.5-36.5] SCREEN: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
[L028 36.4-38.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
[L029 36.4-39.1] CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing): "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
[L030 38.8-41.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
[L031 39.2-42.8] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
[L032 41.0-43.5] SCREEN: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
[L033 43.4-45.4] CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting): "You still think you are better?!"
[L034 43.5-45.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
[L035 45.5-47.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
[L036 45.6-47.4] JULIANA (Serene, Grounded): "I know what I am."
[L037 47.8-49.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
[L038 47.8-49.0] CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking): "A disgraced woman?"
[L039 49.0-52.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
[L040 49.2-52.4] JULIANA (Unwavering): "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
[L041 52.5-54.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
[L042 52.8-54.2] CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged): "You are lying!"
[L043 54.4-58.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
[L044 54.6-58.0] JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic): "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
[L045 58.0-60.8] SCREEN: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
[L046 58.2-61.0] JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing): "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
[L047 60.8-64.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
[L048 61.1-66.8] JULIANA (Passionate, Clear): "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
[L049 64.5-67.0] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
[L050 67.0-69.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
[L051 67.2-68.9] JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious): "Let him have Clarissa."
[L052 69.0-71.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
[L053 69.6-71.2] JULIANA (Proud): "He lost me."
[L054 71.2-73.3] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
[L055 71.3-73.2] CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious): "You were rejected!"
[L056 73.3-75.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
[L057 73.4-77.6] JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful): "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
[L058 75.5-77.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
[L059 77.5-80.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
[L060 77.8-79.4] CATHERINE (Disdainful): "Your soldier?"
[L061 80.0-82.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
[L062 80.2-82.0] JULIANA (Tender, Certain): "My husband."
[L063 82.5-84.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
[L064 82.5-84.0] CATHERINE (Bitter): "He is a nobody."
[L065 84.1-86.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
[L066 84.2-86.2] JULIANA (Warm, Defiant): "Then I love a nobody."
[L067 86.5-89.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
[L068 86.5-90.2] JULIANA (Resonant, Moving): "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
[L069 89.8-92.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
[L070 90.1-92.6] CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp): "You know nothing about my world."
[L071 92.8-97.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
[L072 93.2-96.6] JULIANA (Knowing, Sober): "I know exactly what your world values."
[L073 97.0-99.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
[L074 97.6-99.6] JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate): "Beauty. Money."
[L075 99.8-101.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
[L076 101.0-103.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
[L077 101.2-103.5] JULIANA (Firm): "Family. A perfect name."
[L078 103.7-107.0] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
[L079 103.8-107.2] JULIANA (Continuing): "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
[L080 107.0-108.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
[L081 107.2-108.8] CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged): "And what is wrong with that?!"
[L082 108.8-109.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
[L083 109.4-112.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
[L084 109.5-112.8] JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating): "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
[L085 112.5-116.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
[L086 112.8-116.0] JULIANA (Unrelenting): "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
[L087 116.0-116.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
[L088 116.8-119.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
[L089 116.9-119.5] JULIANA (Piercing): "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
[L090 119.5-121.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
[L091 119.6-121.8] CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming): "Silence! Silence!"
[L092 121.8-123.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
[L093 121.8-122.8] CATHERINE (Shrieking): "Why?!"
[L094 122.8-125.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
[L095 123.0-125.2] JULIANA (Forceful): "Because I am right!"
[L096 125.0-128.5] SCREEN: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
[L097 125.4-128.8] JULIANA (Scathing, Direct): "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
[L098 128.5-131.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
[L099 129.0-131.6] JULIANA (Continuing): "You want everyone to fear you."
[L100 131.8-134.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
[L101 132.0-134.0] JULIANA (Mocking, Direct): "But look at you."
[L102 134.8-138.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
[L103 135.0-138.6] JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare): "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
[L104 138.5-140.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
[L105 138.6-140.2] CATHERINE (Choking with Rage): "You insolent—!"
[L106 140.4-142.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
[L107 140.4-142.3] JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant): "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
[L108 142.4-146.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
[L109 142.4-146.5] JULIANA (Final, Condemning): "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
[L110 146.5-148.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
[L111 146.6-148.1] CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting): "You think you can lecture me?!"
[L112 148.0-150.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
[L113 148.0-150.8] ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
[L114 148.1-151.2] CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal): "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"
[L115 150.8-152.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
[L116 151.2-154.4] ACTION: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.
[L117 152.0-154.4] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "Defying the Branding Iron", "segments": [{"start_line": "L112", "end_line": "L117"}], "hook_line": "L112", "hook": "Catherine raises a glowing branding iron high above her head with maniacal intent, immediately establishing a life-or-death confrontation.", "hook_quote": "Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.", "cliffhanger_line": "L117", "cliffhanger": "The iron is inches from Juliana's eye; will she be blinded?", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "It starts at the peak of the conflict and forces the viewer to watch the outcome of a brutal threat.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 10}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "Defying the Branding Iron": total duration 6.4 s is outside 20-60 s

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
